notes: Marginalia (x.com/marginalia_md): notes in the margin of every trade, for Ethereum mainnet, paired with IMD. Marginalia is the launch ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. MarginaliaHook takes PoolManager, launch token and launch factory in that order; its five declared permissions encode flags 0x20cc. All enabled callbacks require PoolManager. beforeInitialize binds one pool and requires the supplied factory and LP fee 12500. The hook's constructor deploys MarginaliaTreasury, MarginaliaRouter and MarginaliaJudge; discover them through hook.treasury(), hook.router() and hook.judge(). No contract has an owner, admin, upgrade or pause. Buying MARG through the router with a note in hookData posts a falsifiable call on any ERC-20: a flat 0.1 IMD stamp to the pot and a flat 0.5 IMD-equivalent MARG deposit locked for the horizon; sells of MARG pay 1% with a note and 3% without, kept in IMD in the pot; the hook's own deposit-return swaps are exempt. Notes resolve against the median of at least three on-chain price observations in a 6-hour window after the horizon with a balance hold rule; right deposits return fee-free as IMD; wrong, broken and retracted deposits forfeit to the pot. The judge buys one IdentityMD oracle ranking per week of the week's long-form theses (Intake 0x1397434cd35e8a9C8aC312A61D3A285EB31dea56, oracle.request@oracle-1, live price up to 1 IMD) and the hook pays 50/30/20 of the week's thesis pool to the best-argued theses. The three companions are EIP-1167 clones of the implementations deployed by the preceding contracts-only launch, whose addresses must be set in src/MarginaliaImpls.sol before this build.
